title: Llama in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x="34" y="70" width="7" height="22" rx="3" fill="#e8c9a0"/>
  <rect x="59" y="70" width="7" height="22" rx="3" fill="#e8c9a0"/>
  <rect x="34" y="86" width="8" height="6" rx="2" fill="#c9a878"/>
  <rect x="59" y="86" width="8" height="6" rx="2" fill="#c9a878"/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="62" rx="22" ry="16" fill="#f2d8b0"/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <ellipse cx="72" cy="58" rx="6" ry="7" fill="#e8c9a0"/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <rect x="30" y="26" width="13" height="30" rx="6" fill="#f2d8b0"/>
  <!-- scarf -->
  <rect x="27" y="50" width="20" height="8" rx="3" fill="#ff5566"/>
  <rect x="24" y="56" width="7" height="14" rx="3" fill="#ff5566"/>
  <rect x="24" y="68" width="7" height="4" rx="2" fill="#ff8899"/>
  <rect x="31" y="51" width="3" height="6" fill="#ff8899"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx="37" cy="22" rx="13" ry="11" fill="#f2d8b0"/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx="29" cy="11" rx="3.5" ry="6" fill="#e8c9a0" transform="rotate(-15 29 11)"/>
  <ellipse cx="45" cy="11" rx="3.5" ry="6" fill="#e8c9a0" transform="rotate(15 45 11)"/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx="33" cy="27" rx="8" ry="5.5" fill="#f7e6cc"/>
  <!-- nostrils -->
  <circle cx="30" cy="26" r="1.2" fill="#c9a878"/>
  <circle cx="35" cy="27" r="1.2" fill="#c9a878"/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx="41" cy="20" r="2.6" fill="#5a3a2a"/>
  <circle cx="41.8" cy="19.2" r="0.9" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M29 30 Q33 33 37 30" stroke="#c9a878" stroke-width="1.4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- cheek blush -->
  <circle cx="45" cy="26" r="2.5" fill="#ffb3bb" opacity="0.8"/>
</svg>
